title: A Systematic Study of Knowledge Distillation for Natural Language Generation with Pseudo-Target Training

layout.note: A banner box on top states the realistic setting; below it eight stage headings run left to right joined by heavy arrows, each heading above a column of two to four coloured option boxes, with one wide grey No PTs bar across the S4-S8 columns; a pale green vertical rule at the right sets off the Extreme setup column.

lesson: Draw a staged study as a row of titled stages with a menu of option boxes under each and mark the chosen option by a heavy outline, so the chosen path reads left to right; give each stage its own hue and use grey for the plain baseline.
